growth.title: Mubadala’s ADIC invests in US hedge fund’s $2bn capital raise
growth.description: Abu Dhabi Investment Council (ADIC), a sovereign wealth fund, has reportedly invested in a $2 billion fundraising round by US hedge fund ExodusPoint Capital. The new capital has increased the hedge fund’s total assets to $14.5 billion, Bloomberg reported, citing unidentified sources. ADIC is wholly owned by Mubadala Investment Company. risk.title: AirAsia delays opening of Bahrain base
risk.description: Malaysian low-cost airline AirAsia has pushed back the launch of its Middle East base in Bahrain because of the US-Israeli war with Iran. Operations are now likely to start in August or September, subject to market conditions, the airline said in a statement. risk.title: Libya’s oil income rises in May on stronger crude prices
risk.description: Surging oil prices earned Libya bumper revenues in May, making the north African country a beneficiary of the Strait of Hormuz crisis caused by the Iran conflict. world.title: Kuwait joins launch of $10bn AI infrastructure venture
world.description: Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) has joined the quartet led by US asset manager KKR to launch a new company to provide infrastructure for artificial intelligence (AI) hyperscalers. The other partners in the $10 billion venture, called Helix Digital Infrastructure, are chip maker Nvidia and Vistra, a power generation company, KKR said in a statement.
